bullets.text: Velachery residents and groups demand a permanent mitigation plan as heavy overnight rain has caused severe flooding in AGS Colony and Ram Nagar.
PMK chief Anbumani Ramadoss has strongly condemned the TVK government and demanded the removal of the Pallikaranai wetland wall causing floods.
Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay instructed District Collectors to take precautionary measures for the northeast monsoon to prevent any loss of life.
The Tamil Nadu government is advancing the proposed elevated corridor project connecting Chennai Lighthouse with Thiru.Vi.Ka. Bridge to ease traffic.
Residents in the 174th ward of Adyar zone have raised complaints regarding high mosquito infestation inside the large Velachery mall.
Workers fear disease outbreaks as garbage stagnates in drains across the Gummidipoondi SIPCOT industrial area due to recent heavy rains.
The district has organized 103 medical camps benefiting over 3,000 people and has 220 relief centers ready amid the intensifying monsoon.
Southern Railway is launching a 30-day trial of AC suburban train services connecting Moore Market Complex, Avadi, Thiruvallur, and Arakkonam.
Vultr plans to build a 20 MW AI data center in Chennai using AMD Instinct GPUs to support enterprise AI infrastructure needs.
CapitaLand India Trust and CapitaLand India Data Centre Fund launched CapitaLand Data Centre Chennai 01 in Ambattur targeting 53 MW capacity.
IIT Madras Director V Kamakoti stressed the need for frugal AI models to reduce electricity and water consumption for AI technologies.
Udhayanidhi criticized the TVK administration stating that children are not safe under this government following safety concerns.
DMK staged protests against the TVK government over delays in tracing a missing seven-year-old girl from Alampoondi village in Villupuram district.
